question_text: In a single-threaded asynchronous event loop (e.g. Node.js or Python asyncio), what causes event loop starvation?

options.text: Executing long-running CPU-bound synchronous computations on the main thread
Excessive awaiting of non-blocking network I/O
Using too many async generator functions

answer_explanation: Because the event loop runs on a single thread, any synchronous CPU-bound task blocks the execution thread, preventing the loop from dispatching pending I/O callbacks.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: Because the event loop runs on a single thread, any synchronous CPU-bound task blocks the execution thread, preventing the loop from dispatching pending I/O callbacks.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
